questions.response: Life Insurance provides financial protection for your family. Term Insurance: Pure protection, low cost. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Employment details, Income, Coverage amount, Family size, Health details, Address, Pincode, Policy term, Nominee details. Apply via Services > Insurance > Life/Term Insurance.

Health Insurance covers medical expenses from hospitalization, surgeries, medicines. Required: Personal info, Health info (pre-existing diseases, smoker status), Coverage amount, Family size, Policy type, Sum assured, Cashless network preference. Apply via Services > Insurance > Health Insurance.

Vehicle Insurance: Third-party (legal requirement) or Comprehensive (full coverage). Required: Personal info, Address, Insurance type, Vehicle details (make, model, year), Registration number, Insured value, Existing policy info. Apply via Services > Insurance > Vehicle Insurance.
Premiums vary by: Coverage type, age, health, sum assured. Life: ₹20-100/month for term. Health: ₹500-5000/month. Vehicle: ₹2000-8000/year. Use premium calculator or contact for quotes.
Sum Assured is maximum amount insurance pays. Choose based on your needs: Life insurance = 5-10x annual income, Health = 5-10 lakh, Vehicle = vehicle value. Higher coverage = higher premium.
No Claim Bonus (NCB): Discount if no claims made. Typically 5-50% discount on renewal depending on years claim-free. Builds progressively each year.
Claim process: 1) Notify insurer immediately 2) Submit documents 3) Insurer investigates 4) Approval/denial 5) Payment. Most claims settled within 7-30 days. Track in Submissions section.
Pre-existing diseases declared at policy start. Some policies cover immediately, others after waiting period (6-12 months). Disclose all conditions for smooth claims.
Nominee receives insurance payout if you pass away. Must provide Nominee Name, Relationship, and contact. Can update nominee anytime before claim.
Renew before expiry date to maintain continuous coverage. Renewal forms sent to registered email. Can renew online. New policies require full documentation; renewals simpler.
Cashless facility means paying hospital directly during treatment - no out-of-pocket payment. Check hospital network availability before buying health policy.
Insurance = Risk protection (claim if event happens). Investment = Growth (profit if market performs well). Insurance provides peace of mind; investments build wealth. Consider both.
